label: Non-volatile 2x2 GST three-waveguide directional-coupler switch, PIN-heater driven, 220 nm SOI rib, C-band
core_material: Si 220 nm rib on 3 um SiO2 (commercial SOI wafer, printed 'SOITECH'), partially etched 120 nm (100 nm slab); 20 nm sputtered Ge2Sb2Te5 (GST) on the GST-loaded (hybrid) waveguide only; lateral Si PIN heater (p++ / n++ implanted slab, waveguides left intrinsic), Ti/Pd 5/180 nm contacts
cladding: 40 nm ALD Al2O3 encapsulation over the GST; no top cladding stated
notes: Single 2x2 switch element classed by function (D158 / D407; ros2022 precedent; the later chen2024a QC-DC was classed splitter.directional_coupler). Asymmetric three-waveguide coupler: two bare Si waveguides and a truncated GST-loaded transition waveguide, phase-matched only for a-GST (p.3). Endurance count on the sibling phase-shifter row switch_2x2_gst (D396). Doped regions 200 nm and metal pads 1 um from the coupler (design, p.4). Pulses: amorphization 13.6 V, 200 ns, 8 ns edges, 380 nJ; crystallization 3.2 V, 50 us, 6.83 uJ (p.4-5); switching energy density 0.95 / 1.63 fJ/nm3 (estimate, p.5; no parameter). Table 1 'This work' row (p.10) prints ER 10.0 dB, IL 2.0 dB, footprint length 50 um and optical bandwidth > 30 nm: the 50 um conflicts with the 64 um coupling length of p.1 / p.3 / p.9 (D417, length entered as 64 um). No significant spectral drift between 25 and 35 C (p.8-9; Supp. Fig. S15). Simulated FDTD insertion loss about 1.0 dB stated once for the 1x2 and 2x2 designs (p.25), not entered (D254). Fab: author contributions (p.17) name R.C. (fabricated the samples) and Z.F. (fabricated test structures, helped with other fabrications), both University of Washington (D395 / D399). Facility: 'Part of this work was conducted at the Washington Nanofabrication Facility / Molecular Analysis Facility' (p.17), not in the registry (report). SOI wafer from a commercial supplier printed 'SOITECH' (p.11; wafer supplier, note only). Cached text is the arXiv v1 preprint titled 'Broadband nonvolatile electrically programmable silicon photonic switches' (same work as the source row). Garbled text layer flagged on p.15 (references only); values from clean passages and page renders.
